summary: refactor(nl-control): address shotgun surgery on config variable

delivery.outcome: Config mutations are centralized in _persist_mutation/_replace_config; individual NL handlers only compute key-path and message, so the shotgun-surgery smell on 'config' no longer spans eight functions.
nonGoals: Changing NL command syntax, messages or persisted config schema

architecture.decision: Introduce _persist_mutation(key_path, value) and _replace_config helpers so every handler delegates the mutate+save sequence to a single place.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; pure function-level refactor in one module.

validation.evidence: NL configurator tests pass; 'config' mutations confined to two helpers.
